column1: # Source-owned test evidence for bootstrap decision metadata.

column8: The phase leaf does not recreate system-table definitions; it preserves only the source version/mode and schema-preparation ordering, leaving table SQL and metadata IDs to the catalog/bootstrap owner.
Covers the source bootstrap sentinel, startup mode, feature gates, and phase order; does not claim KV/domain/DDL execution, privilege rows, global variables, or a deployable server.
The Rust decision leaf has no retry, transaction, owner-lock, or failure-recovery side effects; those remain explicit external obligations.
Covers the source upgrade/normal version boundary and user/system keyspace guard only; versioned upgrade SQL and DDL mutation remain external.
Schema version ordering is represented as a phase marker only; exact system-table definitions and next-generation metadata creation remain catalog/KV work.
System-table partition/auto-ID constraints require TableInfo and storage metadata and are intentionally not fabricated in this dependency-free seam.
